title: Monthly close status report
prompt: Prepare a monthly close status report using the close checklist, posted entries and reconciliation evidence. Identify outstanding dependencies.
steps: read the close checklist for the month being closed with owners and due dates
for each task, look for its evidence in Dime (posted entries, reconciliations, sign-offs)
list tasks without evidence as outstanding with their dependency

done.text: Every exception row cites the checklist task and the evidence looked for
close-status.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
No task is marked complete without evidence; missing access is stated as such
